shortDescription: Deletes historical results from a scan.

options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: exclude_rollover
options.description: Indicates whether or not to delete scan rollover history. If true, the scan history and its associated rollover scan data are deleted. If false or null and the scan has rollover data, you receive a 409 error "This scan contains rollover scan data. If you want to delete it and all the associated rollover scan data, use query parameter delete_rollovers=true."

options.name: history_id
options.description: The UUID of the historical scan result to return details about. This identifier corresponds to the history.id attribute of the response message from get_scan_history module or the GET /scans/{scan_id}/history endpoint.

options.name: scan_id
options.description: The UUID of the scan whose historical results you want to delete.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.
